title: Rent versus Buying Real Costs

scenes.text: Seattle homes average $800,000—what does renting cost there?
Most people believe renting is always cheaper than owning a home.
scenes.label: Rent is always cheaper

scenes.text: When you factor in rent increases, tax deductions and equity growth, buying often costs less over a 5‑year horizon in high‑price markets.
scenes.label: Buying can be cheaper long‑term
